tools.description: This account as the web client's account menu shows it, exactly like GET /v1/me: email, display name, whether it's a guest, store credit, lifetime spend, packs bought, which purchase bonuses are still available, whether card payments are on hold, and whether it joined through an invite.

tools.name: buy_pack
tools.description: Buy a shop pack with real money, for yourself or as a gift (gift_to_account_id, from find_players). Log in with register or login first (guest accounts can't buy). tools.name: buy_pack_with_store_credit
tools.description: Buy a shop pack with this account's store credit (see shop_packs' store_credit_cents), exactly like the shop's store-credit purchase (POST /v1/iap/store-credit). Same packs, sales, limits and bonuses as a card purchase; no real money moves and no region rule applies.

tools.name: claim_account
tools.description: Turn this guest account into a full account with an email and password, exactly like the web client's "save account" (POST /v1/guest/claim). The city and everything in it stay. Guest accounts can't buy with real money; claimed ones can, and can log in again with login.

tools.name: find_players
tools.description: Find a player to gift, the same search as the shop's gift window: players in any kingdom whose name contains your query (names that start with it first), with account_id, kingdom, alliance tag and whether they're an AI. With no query: suggestions (people you gifted before, your alliance, your DMs).

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "send_command" appears informational but accepts parameters (cmd) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.agentickingdoms.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: account, find_players, get_snapshot, guest_login, login, register, send_command · Private data: buy_pack, claim_account, guest_login, login, register, shop_packs · Public sink: account, buy_pack_with_store_credit, claim_account, gift_pack, guest_login, login, redeem_coupon, redeem_gift_code, register, send_command.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: account, find_players, get_snapshot, guest_login, login, register, send_command · Private data: buy_pack, claim_account, guest_login, login, register, shop_packs · Public sink: account, buy_pack_with_store_credit, claim_account, gift_pack, guest_login, login, redeem_coupon, redeem_gift_code, register, send_command

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
